instruction: Create full promtail config from scratch
output:
cat > /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
server:
  http_listen_port: 9080
  grpc_listen_port: 0
positions:
  filename: /var/lib/promtail/positions.yml
clients:
  - url: http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/push
scrape_configs:
- job_name: system
  static_configs:
  - targets: [localhost]
    labels:
      job: varlogs
      __path__: /var/log/*log
EOF

instruction: Check which files promtail is tailing
output: curl -s http://localhost:9080/targets | python3 -c 'import sys,json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(t["labels"]["__path__"]) for t in data if "__path__" in t.get("labels",{})]'

instruction: View number of active promtail streams
Check promtail sent bytes to Loki
Test promtail pipeline on a log line
output: echo '2025-03-15T10:30:00Z INFO This is a test log message' | promtail -config.file=/etc/promtail/config.yml -dry-run -stdin 2>&1

instruction: Check pipeline stage processing per file
Verify promtail sends to correct Loki URL
Start promtail manually with debug output

output:
cat > /usr/local/bin/promtail-check.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
echo "Checking promtail config..."
promtail -config.file=/etc/promtail/config.yml -check-syntax && echo "Syntax OK"
echo "Checking targets..."
curl -s http://localhost:9080/targets | python3 -m json.tool
echo "Checking Loki connection..."
curl -s http://localhost:3100/ready
echo "Done"
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/promtail-check.sh
ps aux | grep loki | awk '{print $6/1024 " MB"}'

instruction: Purge Loki data to free disk space
output: systemctl stop loki && rm -rf /var/lib/loki/* && systemctl start loki
